storyCards.headline: The last track on the album
storyCards.fact: “Mamma Mia” was the last song ABBA recorded for the album, written by Benny Andersson, Björn Ulvaeus and Stig Anderson with shared lead vocals from Agnetha Fältskog and Anni-Frid Lyngstad.

storyCards.headline: A breakthrough beyond Waterloo
storyCards.fact: The song became ABBA’s first UK No. 1 since “Waterloo” and helped deliver the group’s major breakthrough in Australia.
